key_insight: ClawGym provides a scalable, end-to-end framework for building Claw-style personal agents by combining verifiable training-data synthesis with integrated training and diagnostic evaluation in one lifecycle.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of a systematic, scalable toolkit for developing agents that perform multi-step workflows over local files, tools, and persistent workspace state—particularly the absence of verifiable training data and integrated diagnostics.
method: Model a persistent workspace and tool interactions with a unified Claw-style environment API to represent multi-step workflows.
Automatically synthesize verifiable training trajectories and annotations so generated data can be checked and used reliably for supervision.
Provide an integrated pipeline that couples synthesized data, agent training, and a diagnostic evaluation suite for reproducible iteration and debugging.
impact: Enables AI/ML practitioners to rapidly build, train, and validate personal agents that operate reliably on file- and tool-based workflows, improving development speed, reproducibility, and diagnostic visibility.
visual_elements: Architecture diagram: components for workspace model, data synthesis, training pipeline, and diagnostics with data flow arrows.
Workflow illustration: a multi-step task spanning local files, tool calls, and workspace state changes (before/after snapshots).
Bar/line chart: scale of synthesized datasets versus agent performance or verification pass rate to show scalability and verifiability.
Icon set: verifiable trajectories (checkmark shield), tools/files (folder/gear), and diagnostics (bug/magnifying glass).
paper_title: ClawGym: A Scalable Framework for Building Effective Claw Agents
paper_authors: Fei Bai, Huatong Song, Shuang Sun, Daixuan Cheng, Yike Yang
